verification_notes: IMG_5256.jpeg through IMG_5259.jpeg are overlapping scroll positions of one Hatchery reward result; repeated cards are counted once.

Crimson is the only explicitly verified star-rank change in this result; the screen shows 'Star Up!' over Crimson.
Crimson was previously verified at 1★ on September 20, so the explicit Star Up event records Crimson at 2★.
No exact numeric post-star relic carryover is displayed for Crimson, so its new relic counter is not promoted as exact.

No habit unlock or habit-level change is inferred from star rank or Hatchery rewards.
